The site-naming fix also landed: venue now 'Michalkow airfield, Ostrow Wielkopolski' instead of iteration-1's incorrect 'Leszno area'.

Cost of the deeper class probing: 78.3k tokens / 288 s / 36 tool calls vs 48.6k / 219 s / 19 for skill v1 - still cheaper than the 91.4k / 438 s / 58 no-skill baseline from iteration-1, and it buys the per-class content the task asks for.
